sections.title: Current positions

entries.title: Principal Scientist — Wageningen Food Safety Research (WFSR)
entries.details: Appointed 1 September 2026 as one of four Principal Scientists at WFSR, alongside my role as Head of Data Science & AI. The institute-wide role focuses on scientific leadership and research development; its precise remit is being further defined.

entries.title: Head of Data Science & Artificial Intelligence — Wageningen Food Safety Research (WFSR), Wageningen University & Research
entries.details: Leads an international, interdisciplinary team of approximately 25 researchers. Responsible for scientific direction, team development, acquisition, project leadership and coordination, and the development of AI capability for food-safety research and statutory tasks. Leads and contributes to European research consortia and collaborations with EFSA, FAO and NVWA.

entries.title: Member, Advisory Group on Data (AGoD) — European Food Safety Authority (EFSA)
entries.details: Member of the Innovation subgroup, advising EFSA on emerging data-science and AI directions and their responsible use in food-safety risk assessment and surveillance.

entries.title: Member, Advisory Group — Wageningen Data Competence Center (WDCC)
entries.details: Cross-WUR advisory role on data and digital research infrastructure; recurrent participation in WDCC advisory and joint governance meetings.

entries.title: Programme / governance role — Knowledge Base Data Driven & High Tech (KB DD&HT), Wageningen Research
entries.details: Contributes to cross-WR strategic prioritisation. Project leader of the recurring Small Innovative Projects (SIP) line, including annual themes on Explainable AI and Generative AI. Cross-WR strategic prioritisation and scientific programme development.

sections.title: Open science, datasets and research infrastructure

entries.title: CHEFS
entries.details: CompreHensive European Food Safety database. Harmonised resource containing 392 million analytical results from official European food-safety monitoring; designed for trend analysis, risk prediction and early-warning research.

entries.title: XAI4TTX (2026)
entries.details: open dataset supporting explainable-AI research on tetrodotoxin contamination in bivalve mollusks. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18958220.

entries.title: Weak Signal Miner
entries.details: open-source pipeline for identifying emerging micro-topics and weak signals in large text corpora for regulatory foresight.

entries.title: LC–HRMS foundation-model research infrastructure
entries.details: large-scale unlabeled analytical data and benchmarking workflows for representation learning, transfer learning and downstream food-safety tasks.

entries.title: AI-enhanced news signalling
entries.details: active-learning / human-in-the-loop workflow for prioritising food-safety news and supporting expert emerging-risk identification.

entries.title: Grant review: Hanarth Fonds (2022); Dutch Cancer Society / KWF Round-I (2020).

Journal peer review (selected, historical): Artificial Intelligence in Medicine; Artificial Intelligence Review; BMC Medical Imaging; BMC Cancer; European Journal of Radiology; European Radiology; IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics; IEEE Transactions on Image Processing; IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence; Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging; Scientific Reports; Medical Image Analysis; Physics in Medicine and Biology.
Programme Committee: MICCAI workshop Interpretability of Machine Intelligence in Medical Image Computing (2022).
External PhD thesis assessment / defence participation: Valentina Corbetta (2026); Suzan Vreemann, Radboud UMC (opponent, 2018).
